title: Quick Tomato Garlic Pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and basil. Simmer 8 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.
markdown:
## Quick Tomato Garlic Pasta

**Ingredients:**
- 8 oz spaghetti
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp dried basil
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Grated parmesan, to serve

**Instructions:**
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
2. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
3. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and basil. Simmer 8 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
4. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.
5. Serve topped with parmesan.

*Estimated cook time: 20 minutes*

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
instructions: Whisk lemon juice, zest, garlic, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add chicken and turn to coat. Marinate 15 minutes (longer is better).
Heat a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 5-6 min per side until 165°F internal.
Rest 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the pan juices spooned over.
markdown:
## Lemon Garlic Chicken

**Ingredients:**
- 2 boneless chicken breasts
- 1 lemon (juice and zest)
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper

**Instructions:**
1. Whisk lemon juice, zest, garlic, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl.
2. Add chicken and turn to coat. Marinate 15 minutes (longer is better).
3. Heat a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 5-6 min per side until 165°F internal.
4. Rest 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the pan juices spooned over.

*Estimated cook time: 30 minutes*

title: Black Bean Tacos

markdown:
## Black Bean Tacos

**Ingredients:**
- 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp chili powder
- 1 small onion, diced
- Juice of 1 lime
- 8 small corn tortillas
- Toppings: avocado, salsa, cilantro

**Instructions:**
1. Sauté onion in a skillet with a splash of oil until soft, 3 minutes.
2. Add black beans, cumin, paprika, chili powder, and 1/4 cup water. Mash lightly.
3. Cook 5 minutes until thick. Stir in lime juice.
4. Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
5. Fill each with bean mixture and your favorite toppings.

*Estimated cook time: 25 minutes*
